text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Sweep Tosho achieved a magnificent Triple 
Tiara by winning the Oka Sho, Yushun Himba 
(Oaks), and Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, to become the representative of 
all generations, she set her sights on the 
Queen Elizabeth II Cup, but—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I'm sooo tired~ Familiar, get me 
something sweet~
choice_data_list: Are you still going to push yourself?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's much more convenient to study 
here, after all.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It is a bit late, but... you're gonna walk 
me back when curfew comes anyway, so no 
problem!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, familiar—sweets, 
please~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho has been racking her brain 
late into the night lately, working hard 
toward her next goal, so while I was 
preparing some sweets for her...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (G-Grrrgh...)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Familiar... What was that sound just now?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Bleep... beep... cr-creak... Creak 
creak...! *Puff!*)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Kyaah!? What is this, what's going on...!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Boop... boop-boop!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Beep-beep-beep-beep-beep 
beep-beep-beep-beep-beep!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Kyaaah!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I rushed over to Sweep Tosho, who had 
crouched down. Trying to find the source 
of the noise—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? My hat!? What's the meaning of 
this!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The ears on Sweep Tosho's hat were —moving 
in an abnormal way.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: G-Grandma... My hat is b-broken...

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, Sweepy. The magic on your 
pointy hat just went a little haywire, 
that's all!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Cast a little magic in the workshop and 
it'll be fixed in no time! Don't worry, 
leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Yeah...

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Now then... let's get this fixed quickly. 
...Oh, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Would you care to see the secret while 
you're here?

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I figured it would be best to share 
it with you.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
"The reason Sweepy looks like she's having 
so much fun running in races lately is 
surely thanks to your devotion."

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
"No, even through the TV screen, I can 
tell. I know you truly believe that Sweepy 
will find the 'Magic of Racing.'"

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
"Still, what I'm about to tell you must 
remain an absolute secret from her, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text: Actually, about that girl's hat—

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
――That mechanism is rigged to move in sync 
with the movement of her ears inside.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh... I'm just like Sweepy, you 
see. Once I get into something, I become 
totally obsessed. I used to dabble in 
engineering as a hobby.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
So... please keep watching over him so 
that ear never breaks again.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
The harder her heart tries, the more her 
ears will twitch, and the ears on her hat 
will surely move right along with them.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
However, if the ears move over and over to 
the point where the gears driving the 
hat's ears break—
choice_data_list:
...It would also prove she's pushing 
herself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Yes. But that girl may be selfish, though 
she rarely ever shows any weakness.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It was the same when she dashed through 
the Triple Tiara races. She never once 
said she couldn't do it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter the lineup, no matter how the 
race unfolds along the way, she never 
wavers from her chaser style.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biding her time at the back, believing 
that she could do it, that she could win, 
and never losing faith that she could cast 
magic over the world—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment she crossed the wire in first 
place, she gave me a proud smile, as if to 
say, "See? Told you I could."

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text: "...Trainer, please support that girl."

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
It's because it's you that I can entrust 
this to you.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...! Grandma, thank you!! You put magic on 
my hat again, didn't you!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I layered multiple spells on it this 
time. It shouldn't ever break again!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! Grandma really is the greatest 
magician in the world!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Now, since we're all here, why don't we 
have some tea time together?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'll have lemongrass herbal tea 
today! The tea leaves are on the usual 
shelf, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In a complete turnaround from when she 
first arrived, Sweep Tosho dashed off full 
of energy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I vowed in my heart to keep protecting 
her, so she could forever skip along, 
chasing after the magic.
